doc: Per-carrier contracts, meters. Writers: humans only. Readers: assets/blender/lift_chair.py (rows tr, dq), the cabin / tower / terminal / tram generators (their rows), tests/LiftBatch (drift test vs SkiCatalog.cs, Phase B). hang_m = grip top (rope-side top of the mesh) to the lowest point; grip_top_above_rope_m = how far the mesh top sits above the haul-rope center. Source: docs/research/art/assets-2026-10/design/dq-chair.md section 2; rows gd8 / tram: build/lift_cabin.md section 5 (ROUND-SPEC R27-R31; tram hang 10.50 replaces R5's 7.0), pasted by the gondola/tram integration 2026-10-11. Catalog Phase B (code round 2, 2026-10-11, round-2-contract.md section 10.2 with its skeptic MUST 2): schema stays 1 (lift_chair.py rejects any other); rows tr / dq gain lift_type and speed_mps and dq names its line SkiDetachableHV; rows gd8 / tram are the cabin lens rows (lift_cabin.CARRIERS; the asset gate test_gondola_tram_seams S11 compares them exactly), so their line_prefab / lift_type land together with a lift_cabin.py edit. spacing_m = the DESIGN ride spacing; the line prefab m_Spacing is SkiCatalog SpacingM. Carrier split (carrier grip round, 2026-11-03, docs/research/art/carrier-split-2026-11/build.md section 7): each row's split object names the body and grip meshes (the object prefab keeps its name and shows the body; the grip is its own object prefab, SkiCatalog Names.Grip*) and the pivots in the prefab frame (x lateral, y up, z travel): grip_rope_m = the rope point in the grip's frame, grip_pin_m = the pin center in the grip's frame, body_pin_m = the pin center in the body's frame (SkiCatalog CarrierPivots GripRope / GripPin / BodyPin; body_pin_m + grip_rope_m - grip_pin_m = (0, hang_m - grip_top_above_rope_m, 0), LiftBatch CT-17); grip_origin_z_m = the grip's base pivot above the body's in the assembled carrier (the grip row's y offset on the line prefab); the pin turns pitch and fore-aft only, the wind rolls the whole carrier about the rope point (assembly_roll_max_deg). The tram's K (pivot_k_m) is the split pin, the lug center under the carriage head (10.2565, was 10.38). One writer: the catalog owner (humans), never a generator; mod/SkiResortMod/Systems/SkiCatalog.cs mirrors every number as a literal and tests/LiftBatch CatalogTests CT-11 compares the two.
